title: Python: the 6d constructed arm skips instanceClassOf, plus the round-2 fixture gaps N1-N5 (DEC-303 (a94) round-2 review)
description: Ordinary no-hold follow-up filed from the round-2 reviewer's non-blocking findings on opum-ai/glyph-cli#262 (GCLI-151), as ruled on the #262 landing (ODOC-640, opum-ai/opum-doc#2113): N1-N4 only; N5 rides GCLI-169. N1: the annotated-assign arm (x: C = ...) has no fixture. N2: the !mro.ok fail-closed at calls.ts ~4566 refuses x: C -> x.m() whenever a descendant's MRO fails even with no write, and no fixture covers it. N3: the setattr(self, __class__, X) fixture pins write recording through the own-MRO guard, not a red-before fixture. N4: the R4 local pin is really the 6d single-binding arm; multi-binding R4 has no resolving pin. Scope each before building; any analyzer change is removal-only with a fixture and a mutant per path.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each of N1-N4 is scoped with a measured dev outcome and either a fixture or a stated reason it is not a fixture
Any analyzer change is removal-only, with a fixture and a mutant observed red per path, and removal-only proved by the subset check with flags
